title: SCHC fragment wire format with const generics
description:
src/fragment/wire.rs:
- Fragment<const M: u8, const N: u8, const T: u8> struct
- Ack<const M: u8, const N: u8> struct  
- Control messages: AckRequest, SenderAbort, ReceiverAbort
- compute_rcs() for CRC-32/ISO-HDLC (RFC 8724 default RCS)
- All parameter calculations at compile time via const fn
- FCN_MAX = (1 << N) - 1, WINDOW_MAX = (1 << M) - 1, etc.
